title: Repair-Dependent Competition Between Direct Driver Founding and Stochastic Tunneling Before Clonal Establishment: Reproducibility Code (Paper II)
description:
Reproducibility code for the companion mathematical-biology manuscript Repair-Dependent Competition Between Direct Driver Founding and Stochastic Tunneling Before Clonal Establishment.

The paper-ii-driver-tunneling/ directory contains finite-state killed branching-process generators, exact rational-residual certifications for selected finite-threshold pathway comparisons, tests of model identities, numerical figure generators, and figure regression checks. The same GitHub repository also contains the independent Paper I materials.

These calculations establish strict pathway comparison inequalities at selected parameter values; they do not certify a global number of crossing points.
